description:
Bandit Camp Big Wheel: odds, house edge and expected result of your bets. Exact figures for the Big Wheel (https://rust.wiki/calculators/big-wheel): each number's chance, what it pays
back per scrap and what the wheel keeps; for your bets the `expected_result` over the session, the return %, and
the standard deviation per spin and per session (how far a real session typically lands from the average). The
wheel layout (12 ones, 6 threes, 4 fives, 2 tens, 1 twenty) comes from fan guides only. The page also simulates
whole sessions with a starting bank. Rust's in-game scrap wheel at Bandit Camp, not real-money gambling.

bets.description: Scrap on each number per spin as `number:scrap` (numbers 1, 3, 5, 10, 20). Left out = just the odds table.
